description_en: Lists asynchronous tasks for an instance, supporting pagination and filtering by project, object type, and status

name: ListTasks

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can obtain it by calling the ListInstances interface
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the project. You can call the ListProjects operation to obtain the ID
parameters.name: project_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the object.

● `ModelFeature`: a model feature.

● `FeatureView`: a feature view
parameters.help_zh:
任务对象类型。

● ModelFeature-模型特征。

● FeatureView-特征视图
parameters.name: object_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the object. You can call the ListModelFeatures or ListFeatureViews operation to obtain the ID
parameters.name: object_id

parameters.help_en:
The task status.

● `Initializing`: The task is being initialized.

● `Running`: The task is running.

● `Success`: The task is successful.

● `Failure`: The task fails
parameters.help_zh:
状态。

● Initializing-初始化中。

● Running-运行中。

● Success-成功。

● Failure-失败
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10
parameters.name: page_size
